adaptation.rotation_setup: After MiniDFSCluster starts, call NN BlockTokenSecretManager.setKeyUpdateIntervalForTesting(2000) and setTokenLifetime(2000); a Configuration value alone is in minutes.
adaptation.workload_timing: Hold the first Balancer move until a selected new key ID is exported by NN, its DN update is faulted, NN promotes that ID, and no later DN addKeys has installed it; release move before another successful update. This schedule requires measured runtime admission.

fault.cardinality: one or more distinct command-delivery IOException faults, bounded by original Mallory max3

selected_sites.probe: Read-only post-get observation of actual map result, manager identity, block pool ID, key ID, nonce digest, DN endpoint and epoch; no direct override

required_runtime_witness: Healthy JUnit passes and exact target/typed I/O doors are observed on named nodes.
NN exports a new key ID k; named destination DN command carrying k is received but its pre-addKeys IOException is applied.
No intervening successful addKeys(k) occurs on that DN before its selected lookup; NN later promotes k and Balancer caches a DEK using k.
The same Balancer manager, key ID k, nonce digest and destination bind KeyManager cached reuse to the DN's actual allKeys.get(k)==null.
The unmodified DN guard throws native InvalidEncryptionKeyException and sends INVALID_KEY; original Balancer does not clear the cache and the JUnit fails with no move progress.
A separately SHA-bound fixed replay under the same upstream fault clears/refetches the key, completes the move and passes JUnit.
negative_gates: If the selected lookup is absent, or an earlier SASL/block-token failure stops the move, report a workload gap.
If a later DN addKeys(k) occurs before lookup, report a recovered key-distribution fault.
If only the diagnostic direct allKeys override runs, report diagnostic response behavior and no detection.
runner: none: a source-backed candidate requiring an adapted cluster fixture, read-only key-ID probe, measured schedule and fresh healthy gate before execution
